The instrument features a symmetrical facade with multiple tiers of vertical metal pipes of varying heights, creating a stepped silhouette. The casing is made of pinkish-beige wood with decorative moldings and carved details. A central console area is visible below the main pipe array, though specific keyboards and pedalboards are obscured by the viewing angle and distance.
